name: 100 automated agent scenario reviews
method: Isolated synthetic scenarios checked against predeclared expected fields and Guardian outcomes. 90 model-planning cases plus 10 deterministic policy refusals. No personal user feedback or payment execution.
limitations: Development scenarios include related parameter variants. Wilson bound is descriptive for this selected set; independence/representativeness is not established. Not production reliability or personal earned trust.
